MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 3 RD DAY OF APRIL 2020 
 
 Present 
 
 Imran Ali Khan Chief Executive / Director 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan Director 
 
 Imran Ali Khan chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 EXTENSION OF LOAN ADVANCED TO ZAMEEN ARCS (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to extend the amount of loan advanced to Zameen Arcs (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”) under the loan agreement dated 4 April 2019 , executed by and between the Company and the Borrower (“ Loan Agreement ”), from Rs . 300,000,000 (Rupees three hundred million) to Rs . 400,000,000 (Rupees four hundred million). 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Imran Ali Khan , Chief Executive of the Company, t o discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved, that the Company extend the amount of loan advanced to the Borrower under the Loan Agreement from Rs . 300,000,000 (Rupees three hundred million) to Rs . 400,000,000 (Rupees four hundred million). 
 
 Resolved further, that Imran Ali Khan be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.
